payload.text: After run (2), LIGHT: run this round's 4 new clean.bats arms and 3 hardened ones under bash 5.0, 5.1 and 5.2, and under GNU find. The 4 new: per-node or triple PATH link, '//' spelling, relative PATH link, read-but-not-search dir. The 3 hardened: own test on PATH, vanished tag, e-acute. The runners are the critic's: scratchpad p6/arm.sh <tree> <ver> clean.bats <tag> <regex>, and p6/armgnu.sh with p6/gnufind; the shims are scratchpad shim-5.0, shim-5.1 and shim-5.2. Put the result into the brief before the hand-over, or list it under NOT CHECKED.
